changes: Use ordered metadata streams for author, series and publisher-series lists instead of individual card/source/metadata queries for each book
Keep selected secondary and publisher series positions; preserve canonical book cards
Bound repeated author-name reuse to 8192 entries per live iterator; no persistent result cache
Reuse the existing validated date parser when adjacent records share a date
Count expanded search membership without redundant Books/Series joins
Decode SQLite UTF-8 fields directly; preserve NULL, empty, numeric, long and Unicode values

limits: Disposable synthetic catalogue. First request on a new connection and new list; Windows disk cache is warm from fixture creation, not a cold-disk user-library timing.
Search gains are smaller than the removal of per-book SQL in author/series views. Absolute timings vary with CPU, other apps, result count and selected sort.
SQL profiling overhead applies to query-only profiles; actual_tree and actual Apply measurements run after StopSQLiteProfile.
Deferred startup, publisher language replay and per-tab restoration passed unchanged time guards. No new startup migrations, indexes, file scans or network work.
Not a claim that every broad catalogue search is instantaneous or that the entire application has no remaining bugs.
cleanup: Every fixture created during this task was removed by the native runner. Only the previously blocked HomeLibRu-native-jDA1KD directory remains; no retry or alternate removal was attempted. Working user library and Desktop install were not modified.
